pixel_description: Render only: central single white insulated chamber box, rectangular with galvanized corner/edge framing, sitting on concrete pads via short galvanized feet with visible anchor bolts. Front face has single hinged insulated door swung open ~90deg to right, clear PVC strip curtain hanging inside doorway. Inside, two galvanized slotted-angle rack frames left and right, each 3-4 shelves high, holding blue/grey vented plastic crates filled with lettuce, tomatoes, peppers. Left side wall high: white monoblock cooler outdoor unit with fan grille, mounted through wall with bracket and sealed penetration. Below it on same wall: small white electrical box with grey conduit running down to battery and up to cooler. Left rear separate: grey vented steel battery cabinet on pads with charge controller boxes and thick black + grey cables/conduit to chamber/cooler. Front wall right of door: tiny white thermostat box screwed to wall with thin black probe wire looping from top of doorway down into interior produce/return-air. Roof: galvanized vented gantry frame bolted directly to top edge of chamber, holding tilted blue monocrystalline PV modules (two bright fronts facing right plus dark cell-patterned fronts facing left, vent gap underneath). Right of chamber separate galvanized ground frame with feet on gravel holding row of 5 tilted blue PV modules in line. Gravel/soil ground, six pad positions (five clearly, one occluded). Callouts with thin leaders, no numbers. Critical part chamber: drawn as one enclosing element (box + one open door leaf + curtain), arrangement encloses and supports two rack rows, stands on pads, carries cooler high on wall and thermostat on wall, carries gantry on top; working geometry (enclosure, door opening, interior racks, high-to-low airflow path from cooler forward) visible as in sketch/engineer section.

Also removed all other numeric prefixes ('2x', '7x', '900mm'). No new misplaced callout introduced; 'monoblock cooler' leader ends at cooler wall assembly with conduit, 'concrete pads with anchors' ends on front pad, 'insulated door with strip curtain' ends on open door, PV callouts end on correct arrays. Panel split illustration changed from previous 2 roof +7 ground to ~4 roof surfaces +5 ground surfaces in current view (total still 9 fronts) but total kWp unchanged; crate visibility similar partial view. No new missing part.

s1_differences: No material difference in parts, connections, relative sizes, orientations or directions. All 7 part types present with correct topology: split PV on gantry+ground frames, battery cabinet wired to cooler, cooler through-wall high blowing forward, chamber enclosing racks, thermostat on wall with probes inside, chamber on pads. Apparent count/size/orientation deltas (8 vs 9 PV detections, 7 vs 15 crates visible, 5 vs 6 pads visible, tilted vs horizontal, cooler/control ratios) are segmenter bbox artifacts, perspective occlusion, or required tilt/partial-view, listed as matters=false deviations. Size/shape consistent with ~2400mm box for 1-tonne store.
s2_feedback: No real design flaw exposed. Concrete features: chamber feet bolted to separate concrete pads with anchors, roof gantry and ground PV frame on separate load paths, rear/side-high cooler with bracket and penetration, probe wire from thermostat into return-air/produce with door swing clear of racks, strip curtain and 25mm gaps preserved, no interference or unreachable part visible. Flaw if any would be in unfaithful count, not design.
